messages:
Alex (customer): hi team :wave: my trial credits disappeared after I tried to apply promo code REDWOOD50 earlier today. Dashboard shows promo as 'applied' but balance stays at 0. Account email: alex@example.com, org: tide-co. Dashboard request id: req_02671. Can someone check? I need credits to finish an integration test.

Priya CS: hey Alex — sorry about the trouble. Can you paste the full request id and, if possible, a screenshot? Did you redeem via the dashboard or the API (or both)?

Alex (customer): I used the dashboard and then retried via the API. API call was POST /v1/promo/redeem with body `{ "code": "REDWOOD50" }` and got a 200, but balance unchanged. Account id is acct_9f2b3. No screenshot right now, here's the API request id again: req_02671.

Jared Support: looking into this now. @infra-bot can you fetch the promo redemption trace for req_02671?

infra-bot: logs for req_02671: promo-service returned status=200, message='applied' -> attempted ledger write to billing-bridge failed (timeout). Error: HTTP 504 from payment-bridge; action: rollback issued. trace_id=tr_88a7f.

Evan SRE: we had a transient payment-bridge outage around 2026-03-05T06:12:xxZ that caused some ledger writes to fail and roll back. Team is reconciling.

Marta Billing: policy note: trial + promo credits usually expire per the 90-day promo window in the T&Cs. However, if credits never landed due to our system error we can do a manual grant. I'll need to log a billing case and note the business justification (user couldn't use credits because of our failure).

Priya CS: Alex — can you confirm you didn't consume any tokens after the redeem attempt? Quick check: did you see any usage on the dashboard?

Alex (customer): I didn't get any successful calls after redeem. I tried one test request but it failed with a 502. So no tokens consumed.

Marta Billing: thanks. I'm going to approve a one-time manual grant while finance reviews. Grant details will be recorded under case-2026-0347. Adding 500 promo credits to acct_9f2b3, expiry 90 days from today. Will post a confirmation once processed.

infra-bot: manual grant queued: credit_grant_id=cg_7741, target_acct=acct_9f2b3, amount=500, pending_processor=finance-sync. ETA ~10m.

Alex (customer): amazing, thank you so much :pray: that should let us finish the PoC.

Marta Billing: processed: credit_grant_id=cg_7741, amount=500, expiry=2026-06-03T23:59:59Z, ledger_note='manual promo grant for failed redemption due to payment-bridge outage (case-2026-0347)'. If you need a different expiry window please let us know, otherwise this is a one-time goodwill grant.

Priya CS: closing the loop — credits are visible for Alex, case updated and tagged for postmortem follow-up. Alex, if you hit anything else, ping us and we'll reopen. :thumbsup:

Alex (customer): confirmed, I see the 500 credits and expiry date. Appreciate the quick help!

Jared Support: marking resolved in the ticket system. Follow-up action: Evan's team to add reconciler fix and Marta to confirm finance sign-off.

Evan SRE: noted — we'll add an automated reconciliation for promo ledger failures to avoid silent rollbacks in the future.

Marta Billing: finance has accepted the manual grant. Closing billing case 2026-0347.

Alex (customer): thanks everyone :)
